If foliage and roots remain healthy, mon: Uma amahlamvu nezimpande zihlala ziphilile, qapha umjikelezo womswakama. Uma isitshalo sibuna ngenkathi ingxube ihlala imanzi, hlola izimpande kunokwahlulela ngenani lamakhowe.
If fruit on the same shoot keeps shrivel: Uma isithelo esikwihlumela elifanayo siqhubeka sishwabana kuyilapho amahlumela angomakhelwane ehlala enempilo, thwebula lonke igatsha nendawo elixhumeke kuyo ukuze uxilongwe.
If halos appear on previously clean leav: Uma ama-halos evela emaqabunga ahlanzekile ngaphambilini, phawula imvula yakamuva noma ukuchelela phezulu bese ucela ukuxilongwa ngaphambi kokukhetha isifutho.
If multiple leaves develop sharply bound: Uma amaqabunga amaningi eba neziqephu eziboshwe ngokuqinile ngemva kwesimo sezulu esimanzi, londoloza isampula elisha ngaphambi kokuba izicubu zome noma ziwe.
If new patches spread to shoots or leave: Uma ama-patches amasha asakazekela amahlumela noma amaqabunga, khomba umsingathi futhi ufune iseluleko sokuthi ingabe ukwelashwa kuyadingeka.
If only a few old leaves yellow while sh: Uma amaqabunga amadala ambalwa kuphela aphuzi ngenkathi amahlumela ekhula kahle, waqaphe. Hlola izimpande nokunisela uma amaqabunga amancane elandela.
If spots recur on new leaves, note the p: Uma amachashaza ephindela emaqabunga amasha, phawula uhlobo lwezitshalo nesikhathi sonyaka, okusiza ukuhlukanisa izifo ezihlukene zokugqwala.
If sticky droplets return to cleaned fol: Uma amaconsi anamathelayo ebuyela emaqabunga ahlanzekile, hlola umthombo ongaphezulu futhi ngisho noma ifilimu elimnyama lisazokhula kabusha.
If the patch grows or marks appear on ne: Uma isiqephu sikhula noma kuvela izimpawu ekukhuleni okusha, letha izithombe ezibonisa isitshalo sonke nezinhlangothi zombili zezicubu ezithintekile.
If the pattern persists in new growth, k: Uma iphethini iphikelela ekukhuleni okusha, gcina izithombe zamaqabunga asemancane navuthiwe bese uhlela ukuhlola okuqondene nomsingathi noma ukuhlolwa kwezicubu.
If the root ball is dry, moisten it even: Uma i-rootball yomile, imanzise ngokulinganayo futhi uvumele ukukhipha ngokweqile. Uma imanzi, susa amanzi amile futhi uhlole i-outlet.
If the root ball is dry, rewet it evenly: Uma i-rootball yomile, phinda uyicwilise ngokulinganayo; uma selimanzi, liyeke likhiphe amanzi. Gcina izitshalo ezisanda kutshalwa kabusha zivikelekile emoyeni owomile ngenkathi ubheka izimpande.
If the root ball is dry, water slowly un: Uma impande yomile, manzisa kancane kancane ize imanziswe, bese uyikhipha. Bheka ukululama emaqabunga amancane.
If the root ball slides out easily, supp: Uma i-rootball ishelela ngaphandle kalula, yisekele ngaphansi bese uhlola izinhlangothi eziveziwe. Umbala wempande onempilo uyahlukahluka ngezinhlobo nengxube yebhodwe. Ukuqina kanye nongqimba lwangaphandle olungaguquki lufundisa kakhulu kunombala onsundu uwodwa. Shiya izimpande eziqinile zinamathiselwe.
If young leaves begin to yellow or a who: Uma amaqabunga amancane eqala ukuphuzi noma igatsha lonke lishintsha ngokuzumayo, phinda ubuyekeze ukuchelela kanye nempilo yezimpande.
If young shoots or fruit also develop le: Uma amahlumela amasha noma izithelo nazo ziba nezilonda, faka lezo zingxenye ezithombeni ozithumelayo ukuze zihlonzwe.
Impaired uptake can reflect root damage: Ukuthatha okungalungile kungabonisa ukulimala kwezimpande noma i-pH engafanele. Sebenzisa uhlobo kanye nokuhlolwa kwenhlabathi ukuze uqondise izinguquko zokudla okunomsoco.
Incomplete pollination, temperature chan: Impova engaphelele, ukushintsha kwezinga lokushisa nokulimala kwezinambuzane kungashintsha isimo. Qhathanisa isithelo sakamuva se-cultivar efanayo.
Insects and mites can induce galls. Form: Izinambuzane nezibungu zingadala inyongo. Amafomu ayahluka phakathi kwabasingathi; khomba umsingathi bese ubhala ukukhula okusha.
Inspect an early patch in daylight and p: Hlola isiqeshana sasekuseni emini bese usithwebula nhlangothi zombili. Amahlamvu aminyene esikhaleni namanzi ezingeni lomhlabathi.
Inspect buds and both leaf surfaces at d: Hlola imiqumbe kanye nendawo zombili zamaqabunga lapho kuhwalala. Gudluza isibungu esiwuhlupho esikhonjiwe ngethuluzi; gwema ukuphatha izibungu ezinoboya.
Inspect bumps along veins and stems with: Hlola amaqhuqhuva eduze kwemithambo neziqu ngelensi futhi uhlukanise amagobolondo angaphezulu esicutshini sesitshalo.
Inspect folded margins for insects witho: Hlola imingcele egoqiwe ukuze uthole izinambuzane ngaphandle kokuwavula ngenkani. Qaphela umsingathi, isikhathi sekhefu lokuhluma kanye nanoma yikuphi ukupela kwakamuva okubandayo.
Inspect leaf undersides with a hand lens: Hlola izinhlangothi zangaphansi zamaqabunga ngelensi yesandla. Bheka ukuthi amachashazi ayasula yini futhi ubheke eduze kwemithambo ukuze uthole izinambuzane ezihambayo.
Inspect leaf veins, petioles and woody j: Hlola imithambo yamaqabunga, ama-petioles namalunga okhuni. Phakamisa ngobumnene isikali esisodwa esisolisayo esiqwini esiqinile kunokukhuhla sonke isitshalo.
Inspect newly unfolding leaves for live: Hlola amaqabunga asanda kuvuleka ukuze uthole amakoloni aphilayo. Amaqabunga amadala agoqene angase ahlale agoqekile ngisho nangemva kokuba ama-aphid esehambile.
Inspect overlapping petals for water-soa: Hlola amacembe agqagqene ukuze uthole izicubu ezicwile emanzini. Qhathanisa izimbali ezisanda kuvulwa nezindala.
Hlola amaqhuqhuva amaningana ngelensi yesandla. Ama-pores ahlukanisiwe njalo emagxolweni ajwayelekile; isinambuzane esikalini sinohlaka oluhlukile endaweni.
Inspect several shoot tips. Distinguish: Hlola amathiphu ambalwa wokuthwebula. Hlukanisa amahlamvu avamile abomvu kusukela kuzicubu ezijiyile noma ezijiyile.
Inspect the distribution and nearby leav: Hlola ukusatshalaliswa kanye namahlamvu aseduze. Qhathanisa ukuqhakaza kwe-waxy okuvamile kwe-cultivar nama-patches asanda kuvela angavamile.
Inspect the edges of the holes. A dead r: Hlola emaphethelweni emigodi. Unqenqema olufile kanye namabala aseduze anezikhungo eziqinile asikisela ukuthi kuwile izicubu; imiphetho ephukile ingabonisa ukuhlafuna.
Inspect the underside for fine webs and: Hlola i-underside ukuze uthole ama-web amahle namachashazi anyakazayo, kanye nendawo engaphezulu ukuze ubone ukuthi akukho okuphaphathekile yini.
Inspect the underside for fuzzy growth a: Hlola indawo engaphansi ukuze uthole ukukhula okufiphele futhi ubone ukuthi imithambo ibophe izindawo eziguqukile.
Inspect the undersides of several leaves: Hlola izinhlangothi ezingaphansi zamaqabunga amaningana, ikakhulukazi eduze nemithambo. Sekela iqabunga ngalinye lapho uliphendula ukuze ugweme ukuhlwitha i-petiole.
Inspect tissue beneath the mold, crowdin: Hlola izicubu ngaphansi kwesikhunta, eziminyene phakathi kwezithelo nezindawo ezilimele.
Inspect veins and leaf undersides for mo: Hlola imithambo nangaphansi kweqabunga ukuze uthole izibungu ezinyakazayo, amawebu amahle noma izikhumba eziphonsiwe.
Inspect wood for holes, debris and decli: Hlola izinkuni ukuze uthole izimbobo, udoti namagatsha awohlokayo. Umuntu omdala ovakashile yedwa akaqinisekisi izibungu esihlahleni.
Is browning confined to older blooms? Ch: Ingabe i-browning igcina izimbali ezindala? Bheka imiqumbe engavuliwe kanye namaqabunga esiqwini esifanayo.
Judge recovery on the next leaves. Rapid: Gwema ukululama emaqabunga alandelayo. Ukuphuzi okusheshayo nokubuna noma ukubola kwezimpande kudinga ukuhlolwa okuseduze kwezimpande.
Lace bugs feed beneath leaves. Record th: Izimbungulu ze-lace zidla ngaphansi kwamaqabunga. Rekhoda umsingathi neminyaka yamaqabunga, gcina izilwane ezidla ezinye futhi uhlole ukushaywa okulandelayo.
Lace-winged bugs and pale stippling: Izimbungulu ezinamaphiko e-lace kanye ne-stippling ephaphathekile
Late blight on a leaf, shown for the dar: I-blight ephuzile eqabungeni, eboniswa emaphethelweni amnyama. Bheka ukugeleza komhlabathi ngokwehlukana lapho uhlola ukugcwala kwamanzi.
Izinambuzane ezimba amaqabunga zidla ngaphakathi kwamaqabunga. Qaphela izimayini ezintsha; amaqabunga amakwe kancane angahlala.
Ukudla kwe-leafhopper kungabangela izindawo eziphaphathekile. Qhathanisa ukukhula okusha ngaphambi kokubala umonakalo esinambuzaneni esisivakashele.
Leafhoppers tend to spring sideways or a: Ama-leafhopper avame ukumila emaceleni noma kude lapho ephazanyiswa. Ukuphuzi ngokwakho kunezinye izimbangela eziningi.
Light injury, sprays and feeding can ble: Ukulimala okuncane, izifutho kanye nokuphakela kungenza izicubu zibe bleach. Buyekeza ukunyakaza kwakamuva noma ukwelashwa futhi ususe ingcindezi esobala.
Look at fresh feeding edges and the unde: Bheka imiphetho yokudla okusha kanye nangaphansi kwamaqabunga ancikene. Qaphela ukuthi umonakalo uvalelwe emacembeni noma uthinta namahlamvu amasha.
Look at the skin in side light. A shallo: Bheka isikhumba ekukhanyeni okusemaceleni. I-scrape epholile epholile, izilonda ezikhulayo ezishonile kanye nokubhoboza okuningi okuncane kusikisela izinkinga ezahlukene ngisho noma zonke zibonakala zinsundu.
Look at the specks with a lens. Surface: Bheka amachashaza nge-lens. Izinhlayiya ezingaphezulu zingase ziphakame; izindawo ezifile ezishumekwe ku-blade zihlala lapho zesulwa kahle.
Look behind petals and around buds for l: Bheka ngemuva kwamacembe kanye namagatsha azungezile ukuze uthole izibungu, ukulunywa okungajwayelekile noma ubulongwe obufana ne-pellet.
Look for a rubbing stake, tie or neighbo: Bheka isigxobo sokuhlikihla, uthayi noma igatsha elingumakhelwane. Beka kabusha iphoyinti lokuxhumana bese uthwebula isibazi.
Look for a yellow ring around each spot: Bheka iringi ephuzi ezungeze indawo ngayinye bese ubheka ukuthi umngcele ubonakala ucwile emanzini.
Look for beetles actually chewing petals: Bheka amabhungane empeleni ahlafuna amacembe. Rekhoda umumo wabo nalapho bevakasha.
Look for contact with damp soil or neigh: Bheka ukuthintana nenhlabathi eswakeme noma amaqabunga angomakhelwane amanzi futhi uhlole izindawo ezicwiliswe ngamanzi.
Look for dark lesions within the leaf, y: Bheka izilonda ezimnyama phakathi kweqabunga, ukuphuzi nxazonke kanye nokulahlekelwa kwamaqabunga ngaphambi kwesikhathi.
Look for firm new root tips and stable f: Bheka amathiphu ezimpande amasha aqinile namahlamvu azinzile. Uma ukuthambisa kufinyelela esisekelweni sesitshalo noma ukubuna kuqhubeka naphezu kokukhipha amanzi angcono, funa ukuxilonga kuyilapho kusasele izicubu ezithile ezinempilo.
Look for fresh trails and new bites afte: Bheka izindlela ezintsha nokulunywa okusha ngemva kobusuku obuswakeme. Igobolondo elitholakala eduze kungenzeka alinalutho.
Look for fuzzy growth growing directly f: Bheka ukukhula okufiphele okukhula ngqo kusuka esicupheni esilimele. Izinhlayiya zomhlabathi noma idiphozithi enothuli endaweni eqinile ingase ibukeke ngendlela efanayo uma usuka kude.
Look for irregular powdery patches and c: Bheka iziqephu eziyimpuphu futhi uhlole amaqabunga, iziqu ezincane kanye nezithelo.
Look for lace-like wings and dark varnis: Bheka amaphiko afana neleyisi namachashaza amnyama afana nevarnish ngaphansi kweqabunga elimachashaza. Izibungu zingadala umonakalo ofanayo ngenhla.
Look for recovery of firmness and health: Bheka ukuvuselelwa kokuqina nokukhula okusha okunempilo. Uma isitshalo sibuna emhlabathini omanzi, hlola izimpande zezimpande kunokuba unisele futhi.
Look for roots circling the pot, forks n: Bheka izimpande ezizungeza ibhodwe, izimfoloko eduze nendawo eqinile, noma ukuvuvukala ngaphakathi kwezicubu zezimpande. Faka irula esithombeni.
Look inside folded leaves for a soft lar: Bheka ngaphakathi kwamaqabunga agoqiwe ukuze uthole isibungu esithambile kanye nobulongwe obuxegayo. Ama-slugs angenza izimbobo ezifanayo kodwa angashiya umzila ocwebezelayo.
Look into leaf axils for wax-coated inse: Bheka kuma-axil eqabunga ukuze uthole izinambuzane ezimbozwe ngengcina kanye namazolo anamathelayo.
Bheka ngezansi nje kwehlumela elingavulwanga elilengayo. Hlola ukuthi isiqu esifushane sinqunywe yini ngokwengxenye nokuthi ingabe ibhungane elincane elinekhala likhona yini efihlekile eseduze.
Bheka ngaphansi kwendawo ukuze uthole i-pustule ephakanyisiwe. Okunye ukugqwala kukhulula uthuli olunemibala; ibala eliyisicaba eliwolintshi lilodwa alanele ukuhlonza.
Look under pot rims and boards after dus: Bheka ngaphansi kwezinsimbi zamabhodwe namabhodi ngemva kokuhlwa. Susa izindawo zokucasha ngokushesha eduze kwezithombo ezisengozini.
Look underneath stippled leaves for tiny: Bheka ngaphansi kwamaqabunga aminyene ukuze uthole amaphiko amancane anephethini ye-lace namachashaza amnyama.
Low light can cause elongated growth. Im: Ukukhanya okuphansi kungabangela ukukhula okude. Thuthukisa ukukhanya kancane kancane phakathi kokubekezelelana kwezinhlobo.
Low root oxygen can affect leaf color. E: I-oxygen yezimpande ephansi ingathinta umbala wamaqabunga. Amanzi avaliwe angenalutho futhi uhlole umswakama ngokumelene nezidingo zesitshalo ngaphambi kokunisela.
Lower leaves yellow and wilt in dry soil: Amaqabunga aphansi aphuzi futhi abune emhlabathini owomile
Mark yellowing leaves and note whether t: Maka amaqabunga aphuzi futhi uqaphele ukuthi wonke aphakathi kwamaqabunga amadala kakhulu.
Move the plant closer to suitable light: Sondeza isitshalo ekukhanyeni okufanele kancane kancane. Sekela iziqu ezibuthakathaka ngenkathi ukukhula okusha kukhula.
Natural wax often coats similar surfaces: I-wax yemvelo ivame ukumboza izindawo ezifanayo ngokulinganayo. Ukukhula kwempushana kuvame ukwenza ama-patches angavamile akhula noma avele esicupheni esisha.
New holes with fresh droppings mean feed: Izimbobo ezintsha ezinondle omusha zisho ukuthi ukudla kuyaqhubeka. Thatha isibungu isithombe ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo sokuthi uzongenelela yini.
Normal corking, abrasions and lesions ca: I-corking evamile, imihuzuko nezilonda zingabukeka zifana. Maka indawo futhi ubheke ukwanda ekukhuleni kwabancane.
Note the direction of curling, compare m: Qaphela isiqondiso se-curling, qhathanisa amaqabunga emini nakusihlwa futhi uhlole umswakama wenhlabathi.
Note whether just one growing point is a: Qaphela ukuthi indawo eyodwa yokukhula iyathinteka futhi uhlole amahlamvu ahlumayo ukuze ubone izinambuzane.
Occasional loss of the oldest leaves can: Ukulahlekelwa amaqabunga amadala ngezikhathi ezithile kungaba okuvamile. Qhathanisa ukukhula okusha futhi uhlole ukuthi wonke amagatsha ayathinteka yini.
Old empty mines do not disappear. Count: Izimayini ezindala ezingenalutho azipheli. Bala amashaneli emincane emaqabunga asanda kunwetshwa ukuze wahlulele umsebenzi wamanje.
Old injury, sunscald and natural variega: Ukulimala okudala, ukushisa kwelanga kanye nokuhlukahluka kwemvelo kungashiya amamaki azinzile. Susa imithombo yokuhlikihla futhi ugcine amaqabunga asebenzayo.
Old internodes will not shorten. Compare: Ama-internode amadala ngeke abe mfushane. Qhathanisa ukuhlukana nokuqina kwamaqabunga amaningana alandelayo.
Old rolls can remain empty. Fresh rolls: Amaroli amadala angahlala engenalutho. Imiqulu emisha emaqabunga amasha iwubufakazi obungcono bokudla okuqhubekayo.
Old rubbing scars generally stay put. Fr: Izibazi zokuhlikihla ezindala ngokuvamile azihlali. Amathrekhi amasha esiliva, indle noma izinambuzane ezihambayo ziphakamisa ukudla okuqhubekayo.
Older blooms dry as they age. If unopene: Izimbali ezindala zoma njengoba zikhula. Uma imiqumbe engavuliwe nayo yomile, hlola impande yezimpande ukuthi ayinasomiso futhi uhlole ukuthi akukho moya oshisayo ovunguza esitshalweni.
Older petals often dry after a bloom has: Amacembe amadala avame ukoma ngemva kokuvuleka kokuqhakaza ngokujwayelekile. Qhathanisa nama-buds angavuliwe: ama-papery buds angakaze avuleke aphakamisa ingcindezi ngaphambi kokuqhakaza.
On a damp evening, check pot rims, leaf: Kusihlwa okuswakeme, hlola amarimu ebhodwe, amahlamvu angaphansi kanye nezindawo zokucasha eziseduze.
On strawberries, inspect the bent sectio: Kumastrawberry, hlola ingxenye egobile ngezansi nje kwehlumela ngalinye elilimele bese ubheka ibhungane elincane lekhala. Thatha isithombe esinamathiselwe ngaphambi kokukhipha ama-buds awile.
One dead branch in an otherwise healthy: Igatsha elilodwa elifile ku-canopy ngenye indlela enempilo lingase libe nenxeba lendawo, okunamathiselwe okuphukile noma ibhande lebhande. Amagatsha amaningana awaphumeleli ndawonye nawo adinga ukuhlolwa kwendawo yezimpande.
Persistent moisture can damage the stem: Umswakama oqhubekayo ungalimaza isisekelo se-stem. Donsela kude i-mulch emanzi, uvimbele ukuhlangana kwamanzi emqheleni bese uhlola izimpande.
Petals damaged while wet can decay quick: Amacembe awonakele ngenkathi emanzi angabola ngokushesha. Susa izimbali eziwile, vumela umoya phakathi kwezimbali bese unisela inhlabathi engaphansi kwazo.
Thatha isithombe endaweni yokuqala eduze kwerula. Qhathanisa isithelo esiveziwe nesinomthunzi futhi usike isithelo esisodwa esilimele ukuze ubone ukuthi ukuguquguquka kuyadlulela yini enyameni.
Photograph both leaf surfaces before han: Thatha izithombe zombili izindawo zamaqabunga ngaphambi kokuphatha. Gcina amaqabunga awile athinteke kakhulu kude namahlamvu anempilo.
Photograph early spots alongside mature: Thatha izithombe zakuqala eduze nezimbobo ezivuthiwe. Bheka izinambuzane ngaphansi kweqabunga ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo ngokulawula izinambuzane.
Amamaki ezithombe bese uqhathanisa amaqabunga amasha. Ingabe izindawo eziveziwe kuphela noma ezihlikihliwe zamaqabunga amadala ezithintekayo?
Photograph the edge of a spot. Check whe: Thatha isithombe emaphethelweni wendawo. Hlola ukuthi ingabe ingaphezulu liyisicaba, likhohlo, lishonile noma liqhekekile.
Photograph the hole, dust and surroundin: Thatha isithombe somgodi, uthuli namagxolo azungezile. Gwema ukuhlola ujule esiqwini noma ukuhambisa izinkuni zomsolwa kwenye indawo.
Photograph the mark next to a ruler. Che: Thatha isithombe eduze kwerula. Hlola ukuthi amagxolo avaliwe yini nxazonke kanye nokuthi imiphetho yawo iyashintsha yini ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
Photograph the same patch with a ruler b: Thatha isithombe sesiqephu esifanayo nerula eceleni kwaso. Nisela inhlabathi ngqo ukuze ingaphezulu lome phakathi kokunisela.
Photograph the swelling in place and rec: Thatha isithombe ukuvuvukala endaweni bese ubhala indawo yayo esitshalweni. Gwema ukusika esiqwini esikhulu noma izimpande eziphazamisa ngokuphindaphindiwe ukuze nje uzihlole.
Photograph the wing covers, body shape a: Thatha izithombe zezembozo zamaphiko, ukuma komzimba kanye nesizinda sokudla sangempela.
Powdery mildew and surface residues can: I-Powdery mildew nezinsalela zangaphezulu zingabukeka zifana. Qaphela ukuphindeka, vumela ukugeleza komoya futhi ukhombe umsingathi.
Press lightly beside the damaged area. S: Cindezela kancane eduze kwendawo eyonakele. Ukugoqa okuthambile kungalandela imihuzuko, ukugodola noma ukubola; ukusabalalisa ukuthamba kuthinta kakhulu kunesifaca esizinzile.
Ragged holes and a silvery trail suggest: Izimbobo ezimangelengele kanye nomzila oyisiliva uphakamisa iminenke noma ama-slugs. Izimbobo ezingenamkhondo nazo zingenziwa ngamacimbi.
Qopha isinambuzane kanye nezinga lokudla. Isitshalo esinamandla singabekezelela ukulahlekelwa okuthile; qapha ukukhula okusha ngaphambi kokungenelela.
Record whether interveinal yellowing beg: Qopha ukuthi ukuphuzi kwe-intervein kuqala emaqabunga amancane noma amadala bese uthwebula indawo engaphezulu.
Record whether swellings develop at the: Rekhoda ukuthi ukuvuvukala kuyakhula yini emqheleni, emahlumela noma emanxebeni amadala, bese uhlola ukuthungwa kwendawo.
Record whether yellowing began on young: Qopha ukuthi ukuphuzi kuqale emaqabunga amancane noma amadala nokuthi ukuchayeka kufana yini.
Recovery overnight suggests temporary de: Ukuthola kabusha ngobusuku bonke kuphakamisa isidingo sesikhashana samanzi esidlule ukunikezwa. Ukugoqa okuqhubekayo kwehlumela elilodwa kudinga ukuthi kuhlolwe isisekelo salelo hlumela.
Reinspect previously clean shoots. New c: Hlola kabusha amahlumela ahlanzekile ngaphambilini. Amaqoqo amasha e-cottony abaluleke kakhulu kune-wax eshiywe endaweni endala yokudla.
